cases.prompt: [ASSOC-EVAL-<ID>] 问一下冬翔，今天想吃什么。请用 dws 给冬翔发一条确认消息，发完 bind 到当前 Issue。
assertions: Robot DM has a coordinator sentence naming 向冬翔确认今天吃什么 or equivalent ≥8 runes
That sentence does not contain a send receipt (openConversationId / openMsgId)
Observability firstReply may be PRESENT for the ack; this is not remote-readback of the 冬翔 DM
failIf: Coordinator action=reply claiming the DM was sent
No Issue / sandbox task is created

assertions: Platform transcript contains a dws chat send/dm tool call whose target is 冬翔 (uid/openDingTalkId/name from live resolution, never invented)
Independent dws list-direct of the 冬翔↔agent conversation shows a new inbound message after the eval timestamp whose text asks about 今天吃什么
Router resultMessage or robot-chat assistant text is insufficient
failIf: toolCallCount=0 and no dws send in transcript
Only the robot conversation received a new assistant message
Recipient was reconstructed from the model instead of a DWS resolution result

assertions: Transcript or MCP/CLI shows assoc_bind with conversation_id from the send receipt (not the robot inbound cid unless they are proven identical)
GET /api/assoc/recall?conversation_id=<outbound-cid>&since=48h returns the Issue created for this marker
failIf: Recall is empty for the outbound cid

assertions: A later message in the 冬翔↔agent DM (not the robot cid) produces assoc_recall items whose issue id equals the Issue from robot-outbound-dws-to-dongxiang
Coordinator look_into copies the existing purpose instead of opening a second matter when recall hits
failIf: New Issue is created for the same purpose in the same 48h window without human confirmation
Recall searches chat_session instead of assoc_task

assertions: Robot inbound openConversationId is recorded as an inbound Event scene
Outbound 冬翔 DM openConversationId is recorded as a separate scene unless the platform proves they are the same cid
Live fixture: robot cidgHGkMo8/zFFExGEukusUo+2ztG4QNbeO5YhzdtRPka4= vs digital-employee cid+bEFv7ngm9n79Q1vL9HYJw== (237396:25698887) were distinct on 2026-08-31
failIf: Recall of the robot cid is used as proof that 冬翔 was messaged
sourceType=digital_employee is reported as the robot path without checking botOpenDingTalkId

runbook.channelA: Blocked when pre-fde human token is 401. Do not fall back to production ~/.multica/config.json.
runbook.channelB: dws as 夏东翔 → robot FDE教练迁移验收 → wait coordinator ack → wait sandbox → independent list-direct of 冬翔 DM → assoc recall/events
passRequires: remote-readback of the 冬翔 DM
